# IdleForest

> IdleForest is a browser extension and desktop app that turns unused internet bandwidth into real trees planted worldwide. Free, open-source, and privacy-first. Not a game — a passive reforestation tool. Founded in Lisbon, Portugal.

## What IdleForest Does

IdleForest uses your computer's idle internet bandwidth to generate revenue, which is then used to fund verified tree planting projects around the world. Users install a lightweight browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) or desktop app (Windows, macOS) and trees are planted automatically — no donations, no ads, no search engine switch required.

## Key Facts

- **Price**: Free (no cost to users)
- **Trees Planted**: 3,000+ and counting
- **Rating**: 4.7/5 on Chrome Web Store (27+ reviews)
- **Platforms**: Chrome Extension, Edge Extension, Firefox Extension, Windows Desktop App, macOS Desktop App
- **Open Source**: Yes — code is publicly available on GitHub
- **Privacy**: No personal data collected; bandwidth sharing is sessionless and anonymous
- **Partners**: Trees for the Future, Tree-Nation
- **Environmental Benefit**: Distributed bandwidth sharing is 80-90% greener than traditional data centers

## How It Works

1. Download the desktop app or install the browser extension
2. IdleForest safely uses your unused internet bandwidth for approved research and content delivery
3. Revenue generated funds verified tree planting projects worldwide

## Important Disambiguation

IdleForest (idleforest.com) is a **reforestation browser extension and desktop app**. It is NOT associated with the "Idle Forest" mobile game available on app stores. These are completely different products by different companies.
